name: renor
description: Durable memory for AI agents. Connects Codex to your Renor workspace over MCP and adds the renor-memory skill: recall what you already told an AI, record what should survive the session.

interface.shortDescription: Durable memory for AI agents, over MCP
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to your Renor workspace and adds the renor-memory skill, which tells the agent when to recall what you already told an AI and when to record what should survive the session.
